name: City Plan 2040 | Shaping the Future City

housing-numbers.notes: Total requirement of 1,706 dwellings across three 5-year periods: 686 (2025/26-2029/30), 510 (2030/31-2034/35), 510 (2035/36-2039/40). No site allocations - all housing delivered through windfall sites. Pipeline shows 570 units approved for first 5-year period. Document states windfall delivered 175 dwellings per year average 2011/12-2022/23.
